scope: Fifty bounded prospective original-first map_array specifications only. No native admission, API coverage, blanket parity or speed claim.
unassessed: output_vals shorter than input_vals: unchecked Cython read
numerical_policy: Exact output bytes/dtype/storage metadata, returned out identity/shared memory, full caller buffer before/after states, ordered errors/warnings/protocol events and FP-policy restoration; no tolerance.

safety_boundary.short_values: NEVER CALLED: Cython boundscheck(False), n_map=len(input_vals), unchecked output_vals[i] reads.
safety_boundary.overlap: Only exact input/out identity or mapping-values/out identity cases. Partial input/output overlap never called: prange has cross-index read/write dependencies.
safety_boundary.valid_empty: Owned aligned zero-size arrays only; mapping loop and/or pixel loop have zero iterations as source establishes. No short mapping pair or fabricated addresses.
safety_boundary.snapshots: Original Cython unordered_map copies mapping numeric values before output writes. Existing consumer_map_into stores key->value offset and reads live values; out-is-values needs snapshot-preserving adaptation before native reuse.

native_admission.required: actual native C entry and no whole original algorithm forwarding; not asserted in this reference-only packet

cohorts: u8 dense/u16 sparse/i32 signed/u64 wide keys
future_benchmark.include: public casts, reshape/packing, lookup preparation, allocation and all output writes
